name: B10-0423/2026 – After § 10 – Am 3
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the upcoming EU anti-corruption strategy
part_text: 10a. Strongly condemns any attempt to influence or manipulate media outlets with the aim of hiding, downplaying or suppressing information from the public about corruption and wrongdoing; stresses that such practices constitute a serious threat to media freedom, democratic accountability and the rule of law, and calls for robust safeguards and full transparency in the allocation of public resources to the media sector;
